source_text.body:
Draft personalized recruiting outreach and find candidates
A founder gives Claude a job description and has it draft personalized outreach messages and help find candidates.
·
Apr 13, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
A founder at a 25-person startup connected Claude to MCPs for Crustdata, GitHub, Gmail, and Google Sheets, then gave it each job description and a definition of what counted as role-specific “proof of work.” Claude searched for candidates with those signals, ranked them by fit and apparent openness to moving, drafted personalized email and LinkedIn outreach, and logged candidates and status in a sheet; the founder reviewed the drafts before sending.
How it went
They say it worked better than expected over a few weeks and felt like a genuine upgrade over the recruiter and sourcing SaaS tools they had been using or evaluating. They also say it would not replace a recruiter at scale.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the workflow depends on the founder explicitly telling Claude what evidence counts as proof of work for each role.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Here is the job description for [role] at [company]: [paste description]. Draft [number] personalized outreach messages to candidates matching this role, using these profiles or details: [paste candidate info], and suggest where and how to find more people like them. Stop when the drafts and sourcing suggestions are ready; do not send any message.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1sa8a77/how_i_recruit_using_claude_as_a_founder
